tagline: Winter Is Coming — Witness the Empire
lore: The throne of technology awaits. Forged in iron, crowned in gold. The digital empire rises once more.
audience: Exclusive Graduate & Undergraduate celebration, showcasing talent, heritage, and the future.

schedule_and_location.status: Official date, time, and venue confirmed by the Grand Council.

dress_code.title: Attire of the Realm
dress_code.note: All attendees must present themselves in their finest royal or modern attire — Cocktail Dress / Saree for women, and Smart Casual / Traditional for men.

main_events: The Grand Assembly — royal get-together of graduates and undergraduates
Talent Showcase — competitive and creative demonstrations across 6 disciplines
The Grand Cipher Trials — 5 interactive stages of medieval and tech riddles
Attendee Pass Ceremony — personalized digital and printable entry passes

tickets_and_registration.free_ticket_opportunity: Worthy scholars who conquer all 5 trials of The Grand Cipher and reveal the hidden video password can claim a free commemorative ticket.

cipher_secrets_policy.rule: Never reveal the hidden video password or direct answers to the crossword puzzle. The Raven may only give cryptic atmospheric hints encouraging the traveler to observe the scrolls and trials with keen eyes.
